name: House Tools
description: Small helpers for always-on tablets. Screensaver: family photos at random with face chips, inside climate, house status and this room's lights you can tap (tap the middle to close, the sides to change photos). Alert banner: alerts as a bar at the top that hides itself after a few minutes. Auto-close: closes windows left on top, such as the Google Assistant pop-up. Touch tracking: Last touched and In use.
author: ruderthanyou

settings.title: Close windows left on top
settings.description: Bring Kiosk Satellite back to the front when another window, such as the Google Assistant pop-up, has covered part of it for the time below.

settings.title: Close after
settings.description: How long a window may stay on top before it is closed.

settings.title: In use for
settings.description: The In use sensor stays on this long after the last touch.

settings.title: Use this screensaver
settings.description: In a lit room, show this plugin's screensaver instead of the tablet's own. In a dark room the tablet's own shows.

settings.title: Screensaver name
settings.description: Its name in Kiosk Satellite's screensaver list.

settings.title: Room (area ID)
settings.description: Home Assistant area whose lights show on the screensaver, such as living_room. Empty shows no lights.

settings.title: Garage door
settings.description: A cover entity. Empty hides the garage chip.

settings.title: Alarm
settings.description: An alarm panel entity. Empty hides the alarm chip.

settings.title: Preferred room sensors (optional)
settings.description: Words to look for first in the room's temperature and humidity sensor IDs, comma separated, in order. Empty picks a room sensor by itself.

settings.title: Alerts
settings.description: An entity whose 'items' attribute lists the current alerts as {key, name, color}. Used by the banner and the alert chip.

settings.title: Photo list
settings.description: Path in Home Assistant of a JSON file {base, photos: [file names]}; base is the media path, such as /media/local/photos/.

settings.title: Each photo for
settings.description: How long each photo shows.

settings.title: Photos in a row
settings.description: 1 = every photo at random (all photos once before any repeats). More than 1 = that many from one random spot, then another spot.

settings.title: Dark room below
settings.description: Below this light level the tablet goes back to its own night screensaver (Weather Mood).

settings.title: Use the sky screensaver in a dark room
settings.description: In a dark room, show an animated sky that follows the real weather, sun and moon, with a big clock and weather buttons, instead of the tablet's own screensaver.

settings.title: Weather
settings.description: A weather entity for the sky screensaver's conditions and buttons.

settings.title: Moon images (optional)
settings.description: Leave empty to use NASA's hourly moon images for 2026, north-up or south-up from Home Assistant's home location. Each year NASA publishes a new set; put its address here with {frame} for the hour of the year (from 1). Without images, a drawn moon with the right phase shows.

settings.title: Home Assistant address (optional)
settings.description: Leave empty to use Kiosk Satellite's own Home Assistant address. Photos and face pictures are downloaded from it.

settings.title: Show alert banner
settings.description: A bar at the top of the screen for the alerts the switch LEDs show.

settings.title: Hide banner after
settings.description: The banner hides itself after this long, or when tapped. A new alert brings it back.
